name: Sveglia
author: Jack Thorne
description: A countdown in the bar. Pick a duration and the number ticks down where you can see it; the alarm is a transient systemd user unit, so it fires once and survives a shell restart. No account, no network, no CLI.

barWidget.description: A countdown timer — a glyph when idle, the time remaining when running.

schema.label: Show with no timer running
schema.description: Off hides the widget until a timer is counting — bind omarchy-shell sveglia toggle to a key first, or you cannot start one.
